mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_DATE AS boardDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R WHERE R.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS replyCount FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_TYPE = 3 ORDER BY B.BOARD_DATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_CON AS boardCon, B.BOARD_MOD_DATE AS boardModDate, B.BOARD_DATE AS boardDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R WHERE R.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS replyCount FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.BOARD_TYPE = 3

SELECT boardNo, memberNo, boardType, boardTitle, boardDate, nickname, replyCount FROM (SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_DATE AS boardDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R WHERE R.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS replyCount,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.BOARD_DATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC) AS rn FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_TYPE = 3)
WHERE rn BETWEEN #{param1} AND #{param2} ORDER BY rn
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_TYPE = 3

SELECT B.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, B.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, B.BOARD_TYPE AS boardType, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_DATE AS boardDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPLY R WHERE R.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS replyCount FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_TYPE = 3 AND ((#{param1} = 'title' AND B.BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{param2} || '%') OR (#{param1} = 'content' AND B.BOARD_CON LIKE '%' || #{param2} || '%') OR (#{param1} = 'nickname' AND M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{param2} || '%')) ORDER BY B.BOARD_DATE DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC
